snippet.textDisplay:
My observations:
- Compared to past GTA games, GTA 6 has an egregious amount of tedium. GTA 5's story was much faster-paced if you wanted it to be. 
- In this, you have house chores, washing boats, rebuilding a house for extended periods, grand meditative tasks, driving your girlfriend to work, doing numerous tasks that do very little, and spending numerous times in cutscenes that slow down the momentum of everything.
- Remember in GTA 5 that you were plotting to rob banks or jewelry stores, spending missions getting it ready to go? GTA 6, several hours in and its.....nothing.
- GTA 6 is more of a slice-of-life simulator with GTA sprinkled into it. 
- The game is pretty. The environments look great. 
- The story is bland. The main characters are bland as hell. 
- With RDR2, it was an incredibly immersive environment, with a dynamic and faster-paced story. You could do anything you want, cut out of the main story for a while and do side quests/explore, and you felt rewarded for doing it. Not so much with GTA 6.
- The gameplay is good. The soundtrack is good.
- The dialogue is hit or miss. At times, the dialogue can be downright terrible or annoying. 
- Lucia is naggy at times. Jason is duller and way too calm for a character. These are not criminals. 
- After seeing all this, the game is boring. It's not a terrible game, but I'd never want to play it. This is not a 10/10 game. I want GTA 5, or anything else, for that matter.

Soo....I took basically a 15 year break from gaming. I grew up on warcraft/starcraft/wow/MW2/GTA (the golden age) etc etc..Long story short , when I heard this game was coming out, I was so far beyond excited. But...upon further examination I came to a stunning realization that one of my favorite games was being ruined just like all my favorite childhood shows and movies. However, I did not think they would neuter GTA.

I would have to buy a PS5/XBOX to play the game .. This is not am investment I take lightly, so I thought I would watch some youtubers and get their opinions. Let me be clear, I have no idea who this man is. But along the way I watched him play some other games like expedition 33, crimson desert, and some other ones he truly seemed to enjoy it. When he was playing expedition 33, he had a shite eating frin on his face. It seemed like he was truly immersed. Same with crimson desert.

I need to be clear here, I have to take him at fave value when he says he likes something. I simply dont know him well enough to say one way or another. And even if I did watch him enough to know, it would be wrong to just flat out accuse him of saying he is lying. Thats a huge gripe I have, specifically with the left, so I will not engage in the same behavior...but his mannerisms and the way he is reacting is similar to almost all other streamers.

It doesnt look like people are **truly** enjoying it. Normally, there will be very obviois signs. There is a certain undeniable body language, its universal, when somebody is happy. They wont spend multiple times making fun kf it, or scoffing at stupid troupes being put it..Outside of a few people, there is nobody truly truly getting hyped. The game seems lifeless, along with the streamers playing them. But after playing everybody says its a 9 or a 10. I dont sense or see the glee, and the reasons given for such a high score dont seem to line up. But when I look at comments, most people simply dont like it. I think it would be a stretch to say its a bad game, but this really doesn't look or act like GTA. He himself has said he needs to finish the game before he judges, which I can respect. I did notice his views were up and down with crimson desert, which is consistent with somebody not acting on an impulse. Its pretty hard to say a game sucks if you havent finished it.

This game LOOKS amazing. But wtf.. what the hell is this story? I am apolitical, I dont support a side. But this game has all the hallmarks of leftist non sense. I know he said he didnt play the previois GTAs, but I think it would have helped him gain some frame of references. This doesnt make his view any less credible. With that being said, I do  think if he grew up on it, the way he did WOW, maybe his opinion would be different? 

Am I crazy?? Again, this is more or less about noticing very specific patterns in how people are acting when they are playing, and noticing things in the gameplay. Where ever these leftists go, they are not fundamentally capable of being objectice and biased. They quite literally cant help themselves.

I also noticed the game of the year award they might win, and all the amazing ratings. Did they just throw a ton of money at all these outlits and streamers just for positive reviews??? Its almost impossible for me NOT to notice this.

It seems like people who GREW UP on gta seem to have mostly the same opinion. But people who played the game in retrospect, who didnt live through it, have a different opinion. 

I am so repulsed by this entire situation. Downright disgusted. Why does it have to be this way? I have honestly become very interested in the gaming sphere, as it seems to be the most captured industry on the planet. I truly cant fathom how terribly gamers are treated. Its so in your face, the corruption so blatant. They treat gamers like a bunch of junkies. Hell, my old plug treated me better.

Once one "sees" a pattern, its very hard to unsee them. And there is a feeling that transcends times and cultures when somebody truly likes something. I just dont see it. Peoples words and their body language just dont add up. It is the same on 90% of the videos I have watched. No joke. See, i notice these times where they seem taken aback, or shocked about certain things. Its almost like they have to recalibrate. It looks like they want to say something, but dont. Almost as if somebody paid them off and know if theu say the wrong thing they are kapput. Its hard to turn down money and people are seeing an avenue to future success being in the good graces Rockstar. It looks like somebody has a gun to their head and telling them if they say anything bad then they will no longer exsist. There has literally been 5 different instances where they will start criticizing the game, then half way through, they stop and immediately try taking back what they said. Thats the recalibration I was talking about. I didnt see this BG3/expedition 33/many other games. Well, maybe there was some of it, but it didnt seem like their life depended on it not criticizing them.

I actually almost went out and got a ps5 with out investigating. Im sure glad I did. Reguardless if its good or not, its NOT gta.  To all my brothern who are old enough to remeber the good ole days, I feel your plight. What they have done to our favorite media is a boarderline crime, unforgivable. To asmon (I dont knlw if he reads comments or not) I appreciate what you do. One hill I will die on is free speech. Its the fundamental building block to life. I dont necessarily agree with you on everything, but I like how unapologetic you are about your opinions. What you and Olypmus have done with WoW is quite possibly the coolest thing in online gaming history. I might just make myself an account 😂😂.. Whatever you think of this game, dont hold back on either side. I would be lying if I said I want this game to suceed. As I said, I am apolticial, but seeing these raging lunatics steal our most cherished IPs  and claiming it as theirs, is something that needs to be stopped.. But if you **truly** and I mean **TRULY** from the botton of your heart like this game, then power to you. If I were you, I would play GTA5 at some point. I dont think it will swaye if you like or dislike this game..but I do think it would give you an idea if it were a good **GTA game**..The reason why I mention this is because the situation has parallels to WoW, where the "modern audience" wants the new WoW a certain way. But the OGs want it another way. I really hope this comment doesnt get deleted..

HELL IS REAL


Back in March of 2026, I was living a pretty typical, comfortable life with my wife and kids. But to be completely blunt with you guys, I was incredibly stubborn, and I loved sin. I hadn't stepped foot inside a church in over 25 years, and honestly, I didn't care.But what happened to me last March completely shattered my reality.


I remember the exact moment it happened.


It was late in the morning, right around 10:00 AM. I was lying on my left side, waking up groggily and battling my own eyelids, struggling to force them open. Squinting through the heavy haze of sleep, I was staring directly at the stacked boxes of clothes in my bedroom. Then, out of nowhere, a curtain of complete darkness swept over my sight.


At first, I didn't panic. My immediate thought was that my eyes had simply slipped shut again and that I was falling back asleep. Normally, when sleep takes over, you lose yourself in rest and submerge into comfort. But this time was completely different. My mind stayed unnaturally active and alert. I couldn't put my finger on it, but something deep inside was telling me with absolute certainty: This is not a dream.


That's when the scene played back in my mind, half-squinting at those stacked boxes of clothes one second, and then suddenly being swallowed whole by darkness the next. Without even realizing it at first, I was trapped in a place I can only describe as the "Outer Darkness."


It wasn’t just a dark place. It was a thick, suffocating, crushing blackness of absolute nothingness, a heavy void darker than any place that could ever exist on Earth. At first, I stayed nonchalant. Ignorance truly is bliss, so I didn't think much of it, assuming my eyes were just playing tricks on me while I waited for my dreams to catch me. But then the reality of the environment began to set in, and a creeping horror took over.


It was quiet. Unnaturally, terrifyingly quiet. A dead, hollow silence where not a single sound or vibration existed. Then, things became absolute nightmare fuel. I tried to feel my pulse, but I couldn't feel my own heartbeat. I tried to inhale, but my lungs weren't working, there was no air, no chest moving, no breath. There was nothing to smell. Nothing. Desperate, I focused every ounce of my willpower on my sense of touch, trying desperately to feel... anything. Still, nothing. I tried commanding my body to move. Nothing happened.


Within seconds, I lost all tracking of my physical body. I couldn't feel my arms, my legs, or my torso. I had no idea if I was standing up, sitting down, floating, or lying on a floor. I tried to command my body to lift my hands right in front of where my eyes should have been like I normally do, and right in front of my eyes, I focused, straining, trying to see anything at all... and saw absolute, total nothingness. 


My physical senses were completely dead. Every organ, every nerve, every single anchor to reality was entirely severed. I was stripped of my body, reduced to a raw, naked consciousness, completely and utterly isolated, helpless, and abandoned in an infinite abyss with nothing but my own thoughts. That’s when the full weight of the nightmare hit me like a physical blow, and my stomach completely plummeted.


I realized I was in HELL.


John 15:5 [the Amplified Bible (AMP)] :

"I am the Vine; you are the branches. The one who remains in Me and I in him bears much fruit, for [otherwise] apart from Me [that is, cut off from vital union with Me] you can do nothing."


In that darkness, being completely cut off from God meant being cut off from light, life, breath, and hope. A fear so massive and violent gripped my entire being, surging from the very edge of my soul straight to the top of my mind. I was literally choking and suffocating from pure, unadulterated anguish. My soul was screaming inside that dark void because I knew, with absolute, horrifying certainty, that there was NO HOPE.


Matthew 8:12 [the Amplified Bible (AMP)]:

"while the sons and heirs of the kingdom [the descendants of Abraham who will not recognize Me as Messiah] will be thrown out into the outer darkness; in that place [which is farthest removed from the kingdom] there will be weeping [in sorrow and pain] and grinding of teeth [in distress and anger]."


Right as I was about to break down and beg for mercy, a voice cut through the void. It was stern, but deeply loving, and it spoke directly to me in Tagalog:


"Kapag hindi ka pa umuwi..."

It translates to: "If you still don't return home..."


The second those words echoed, my soul instantly resonated. A realization clicked inside me: That is your Father. That is your Lord. And that is your God. Before I could even try to respond, I instantly snapped back into reality.  I was already sitting right back in my room, staring directly at the stacked boxes of clothes like nothing had ever happened. But the voice had been so loud and clear, it felt like He was standing right next to me. Divine Mercy


The whole day, I tried to act nonchalant and pretend everything was fine in front of my family. But that very night, the walls I had built up my entire life completely broke down. I had to sleep in a separate room just so my wife and kids wouldn't hear me weeping. I was on bended knees, crying like a little child, begging the Lord Our God Jesus Christ to forgive me and to never send me back to that OUTER DARKNESS. I literally fell asleep crying.


A few days later, I finally went to confession for the first time in over two decades. While the parish priest had his eyes closed, praying over me and giving me the Absolution of Sin, something straight out of a horror movie happened. I watched a thick, heavy black smoke literally rise out of my own body. The priest didn't see it, but when he opened his eyes, he just looked at me and calmly said, "Welcome Home."  


I took it as a sign and told him about being sent to Hell and back, and there wasn't even a hint of surprise on his face. He just told me that there have been a lot of supernatural visions lately, and that I was fortunate because I listened, while others simply choose not to believe.  


Since that day, my journey has been one of constant prayer and turning away from my old life. For the sins I am too weak to overcome on my own strength, I beg the Lord Our God Jesus Christ to take that cross away from me and pull me close to Him. 


I don't rely on the strength of my own faith, but on His promise that whoever repents will be saved by His grace and His faithfulness not mine.  Every single day now for LOVE of GOD, I pray Divine Mercy Chaplet, St.Gertrude's Chaplet (x7 daily), Prayer of Daily Neglect, Novena of Surrender & Holy Rosary, to help lower the PURGATORY TIME. Going to Mass everyday and Sunday (Latin Mass) as penance, reparations and sanctification.


As soon as I started praying daily I felt this overwhelming PEACE consume me, I know very well it's not my PEACE, but the PEACE of the Lord Our God Jesus Christ and I know I have a long way to go before I'm sanctified but I'm now living everyday like it's my LAST. Know that I'm always praying for us all and our SALVATION. Looking back, 25 years flew by so fast for me working as hard as I can. I’m pasting this here because HELL is MORE REAL THAN THIS LIFE, and if you are living in SIN, you are walking on thin ice. Take this as your sign to turn around and return home to the Lord Our God Jesus Christ before it's too late.  


When the Lord God Jesus Christ asks me what I did with the vision that He gave me my answer is THIS. I POSTED IT.


"O' Jesus I surrender myself to you, take care of everything."


John 6:37 [the Amplified Bible (AMP)]:

"All that My Father gives Me will come to Me; and the one who comes to Me I will most certainly not cast out [I will never, never reject anyone who follows Me]."
